programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Science Fiction In The Atomic Age
programme.desc: Arthur C Clarke to Ray Bradbury: Explore how WWII shifted literature and media, with American tradition dominating post-war in influence and success. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Peter O'Toole: Along The Sky Road to Aqaba
programme.desc: Feature documentary reflecting on Peter O'Toole's towering theatrical legacy. Includes interviews with Sir Anthony Hopkins, Sir Derek Jacobi and Stephen Fry.

programme.title: New: Portrait Aratist Of The Year 2026
programme.desc: New. Kojey Radical, Michelle De Swarte, Jeremy King: Nine artists capture a celebrity sitter as they compete for a semi-final place. (S3, ep 6)

programme.title: Skinner & Mina's Literary Road Trip: Pope & Swift
programme.desc: Frank and Denise discover how Pope became the poet of the age and find out how Swift's insightful political satire turned him into an Irish hero. (2 of 3)

programme.title: Rolling Stone: Stories From The Edge
programme.desc: Rolling Stone moves to New York, Elvis dies, Hunter S Thompson covers the Pulitzer divorce case, and televangelists attack the magazine. (4 of 6)

programme.title: The Seventies
programme.desc: The United States Vs Nixon: A look at how the Watergate scandal led to Richard Nixon being the only president in United States history to resign from office. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Andre Rieu: I Lost My Heart In Heidelberg
programme.desc: The violin sensation leads a spectacular musical tour of the German town, giving sensational performances from a romantic ruined castle and a boat on the river Neckar.

programme.title: The Joy Of Painting
programme.desc: Country Cabin: Bob paints an old weathered dwelling, buried deep in the snow and surrounded by protective evergreens. (S11, ep 2)

programme.title: The Joy Of Painting
programme.desc: Daisy Delight: In this dark, gloomy masterpiece, Bob paints a majestic stand of evergreen trees overlooking flowers growing on a sloping mound. (S11, ep 3)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: Parson's Pleasure: Cyril Boggis makes a profitable living as a rogue antiques dealer. But when he buys Farmer Rummins' valuable furniture, his luck may be about to run out. (S3, ep 6)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected
programme.desc: The Stinker: When millionaire Jack runs into Harold, a boy he bullied at school, he gives him a job. But Harold soon suspects his wife of having an affair with his new boss. (S3, ep 7)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: Listen, Listen....!: Not a soul will listen to a mild-mannered man's theory about a string of murders that happen close to home. (S3, ep 32)

programme.title: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
programme.desc: Post Mortem: A wife refuses to let her husband squander a $133,000 sweepstakes ticket inherited from her first dead spouse, so he plans on killing her. (S3, ep 33)

programme.title: The Alfred Hitchcock Hour
programme.desc: I'll Be Judge - I'll Be Jury: Relatives of a murdered newlywed decide to bring the killer to justice themselves. (S1, ep 21)

programme.title: Discovering: Gary Oldman
programme.desc: Gary Oldman: A look at the versatile and fruitful career of the superstar, which includes an Academy Award-winning performance as Winston Churchill in Darkest Hour. (S13, ep 8)

programme.title: Tales Of The Unexpected

programme.title: So Evil, So Young
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars Jill Ireland, Ellen Pollock & John Charlesworth. Framed for robbery and sent to a reform school, a young girl becomes the target of a vicious warden.

programme.title: The Rough and the Smooth
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Starring Nadja Tiller, Tony Britton and William Bendix. Directed by Robert Siodmak. An archaeologist forsakes his fiancée for a passionate affair with a beautiful German woman.

programme.title: The Party's Over
programme.desc: 1965. Drama. Directed by Guy Hamilton. A controversial film of its time. A young American girl is caught up in the wild London scene. Starring Oliver Reed.

programme.title: A Trip into Wharfedale
programme.desc: A charming amateur film on a day trip in the 40s around the Yorkshire dales. Wonderful shots of vintage transport and hotels in the area and high streets.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: William Wyler is the film director that brought Mrs Miniver and Roman Holiday with Audrey Hepburn. His actors won more Oscars than for any other director.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Minstrel's Shakedown. 1966. Stars Adam West, Van Johnson & Leslie Perkins. A new villain called The Minstrel throws the Gotham Stock Exchange into chaos, sending the market into near disaster.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Barbecued Batman? 1966. Stars Adam West, Van Johnson & Remo Pisani. Batman and Robin place a bugging device in Amanda's purse and discover The Minstrel's wicked plan. Can they stop him in time?

programme.title: Fate Takes a Hand
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Director: Max Varnel. Stars Ronald Howard, Christina Gregg, Basil Dignam. Letters recovered from a stolen mail bag significantly impact the lives of the recipients 15 years later.

programme.title: Pleasure Hunt 1956
programme.desc: 1956. A previously lost short about a young man who takes a girl on a day out, where they visit Battersea Funfair in London before going to the Farnborough Air Show.

programme.title: The Dark Road
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Directed by Alfred J. Goulding. Stars Farnham Baxter, Cyril Chamberlain & Sydney Bromley. The story of Sidney Robertson and his rise from a petty thief to an underworld crime boss.

programme.title: Highly Dangerous
programme.desc: 1950. Drama. Directed by Roy Ward Baker. Stars: Margaret Lockwood, Dane Clark, Marius Goring. An entomologist travels to a Balkan country to investigate germ warfare.

programme.title: The Son of Monte Cristo
programme.desc: 1940. Action. Director: Rowland V. Lee. Louis Hayward, George Sanders, Joan Bennett. Rightful owner of the kingdom, the Duchess of Zona, is engaged in a power struggle with the evil General Gurko.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: To the Rescue. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Ewen Solon & Andre Charisse. Tempest arrives in Savannah with the promise of valuable cargo but winds up attempting to smuggle a tobacco crop out.

programme.title: Le Poulet
programme.desc: Le Poulet (The Chicken). 1965. A child becomes attached to a chicken. To stop his parents from eating it, he places an egg near the animal every morning, making it seem like a hen.

programme.title: My Cousin Rachel (1952)
programme.desc: 1952. Mystery. Directed by Henry Koster. Stars Olivia de Havilland, Richard Burton & Audrey Dalton. The heir to a considerable fortune attempts to find out if the woman he loves is a murderess.

programme.title: Hobson's Choice
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director: David Lean. Stars Charles Laughton, John Mills & Brenda de Banzie. Henry Hobson's three daughters want to marry, but he refuses as traditions require him to pay settlements.

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Muriel and Sally Pt1. Stars: Vivienne Burgess, Tessa Wyatt and Lindsay Ingram. Two people who are widely separated by personality and character are brought together by just one factor...

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Muriel and Sally Pt2. Stars: Vivienne Burgess, Tessa Wyatt and Lindsay Ingram. After listening to Muriel's story, it is now Sally's turn to tell hers.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Trammel Nets/Coach Builder. 1986. Two more excerpts from Jack Hargreaves's archive as he goes inshore fishing with a three-tiered net and visits a factory that makes wooden cart wheels.

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The Whipping Boy. 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, Christopher Benjamin & David Daker. The rivalry between the Captain & the Colonel rears up again, leaving Spiker demoted and Moat imposing terror.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Rich Man, Poor Man. Stars Barry Foster, Michael Latimer & Susan Travers. An explosion almost kills a worker at a factory, and a poor immigrant barber is beaten to death in a luxury apartment.

programme.title: Modesty Blaise
programme.desc: 1966. Action. Director: Joseph Losey. Stars Monica Vitti, Dirk Bogarde & Terrence Stamp. A spy spoof in the 60s tradition with comic book heroine, Modesty Blaise. Set in the Italian Mediterranean.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: 1978. Comedy. Director: Stanley Long. Stars Chris Neil, Christopher Biggins, Lindy Benson. Plumber's mate Sid meets ladies at work. Susie is unaware of his dalliances as he gets into debt trouble.

programme.title: Meet Mr Callaghan
programme.desc: 1954. Crime drama directed by Charles Saunders. Private detective Slim Callaghan (Derrick De Marney) is hired to find out why a rich uncle changed his will.

programme.title: The Detectives
programme.desc: A Barrel Full Of Moneys. Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Swindler. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Spell of Tut. 1966. Stars Adam West, Victor Buono & Marianna Hill. Batman and Robin battle the nefarious King Tut who plots to take over Gotham City with an ancient potion.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Tut's Case is Shut. 1966. Stars Adam West, Marianna Hill, Sid Haig. Robin reveals that Gordon's secretary, Miss Cleo Patrick, is working for Tut and plans to slip the Commissioner a scarab mickey.

programme.title: The Rossiter Case
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Directed by Francis Searle. Stars Helen Shingler, Clement McCallin & Sheila Burrell. After an accident results in her paralysis, a woman fears that her husband will abandon her.

programme.title: Confession

programme.title: My Bakery in Brooklyn
programme.desc: After the sudden death of their aunt Isabelle, Vivien and Chloe inherit her historic bakery. Vivien wants to keep up the tradition; Chloe feels that the business needs to be modernised. When notified that they are about to be evicted, the two do not hesitate to work together to preserve the family legacy. Romantic comedy, starring Griffin Newman, Krysta Rodriguez and Aimee Teegarden

programme.title: My Name Is Nobody
programme.desc: Spaghetti western starring Henry Fonda and Terence Hill. A top gunfighter hopes to find peaceful retirement in Europe, but the persistent admiration of a young man called Nobody stops him hanging up his pistol, until he can defeat the 150 horsemen of the "Wild Bunch".

programme.title: Attack Of The Lederhosen Zombies
programme.desc: Three snowboarders are left behind on an Austrian mountain at an après-ski tavern. When an experiment to create artificial snow unleashes a zombie epidemic, the friends and buxom tavern owner must survive their wurst nightmares!

programme.title: Gorgo
programme.desc: Monster adventure starring Bill Travers and William Sylvester. A prehistoric monster is captured off the coast of Ireland and brought to London where it is exhibited in a circus. But having determined that the monster is an infant, scientists suspect that one of its parents may also still be alive.

programme.title: Love's Second Chance
programme.desc: Romance starring Gabrielle Christian and Cody Ray Thompson. Rose returns to her home town to take over her grandmother's dress shop and meets old high-school crush Cole.

programme.title: Love at Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: Tired of her fast-paced life and marketing job, a woman travels to a seaside town, staying with a father and daughter - but romance stirs. Romantic drama, starring Carlo Marks, Meghan Heffern and Ellen Woglom

programme.title: A Handful of Dust
programme.desc: Period drama starring James Wilby and Kristen Scott Thomas. Brenda Last has everything that other women would envy - a loving and aristocratic husband, an adorable son and a huge stately home in the country. But for an amusing diversion, Brenda starts an affair with a social-climbing scrounger from London. It is the start of an inexorable slide to disaster.

programme.title: Bad Man's River
programme.desc: Four outlaws accept the job of blowing up a government arsenal in Mexico, but find themselves constantly outwitted by a clever woman. Comedy Western, starring Lee Van Cleef, Gina Lollobrigida and James Mason

programme.title: The Charm of Love
programme.desc: Romance starring Katrina Norman and Tilky Jones. An archaeologist travels the world searching for the "Lovers' Stone" but finds a man instead.

programme.title: Christmas on Holly Lane
programme.desc: Drama starring Sarah Lancaster, Karen Holness and Gina Holden. Three friends with troubled lives who meet every year for Christmas fear this might be their last together.

programme.title: Bonds Will Be Broken
programme.desc: When her sister Nina is seduced by a mysterious self-improvement cult, Anna decides to go undercover at the cult's annual retreat to save her sister from the sinister cult leader.

programme.title: Toast
programme.desc: Young Nigel Slater has big culinary aspirations, even though all his mother knows how to make is toast. When his mother dies, relations grow strained between Nigel and his father, especially when he remarries a woman who wins his heart with a lemon meringue pie. Nigel enters culinary school, starts working in a pub and finds himself competing with his stepmother -- both in the kitchen and for his father's attention. Biographic drama Starring Freddie Highmore and Helena Bonham Carter

programme.title: Buster
programme.desc: Crime drama based on the life of Great Train Robber Buster Edwards, starring Phil Collins and Julie Walters. A small-time crook gets the chance to move into the big time when he becomes part of a gang planning to rob the Royal Mail train of more than £2 million - a crime that will go down in history.

programme.title: Hot Property
programme.desc: A corporate spy loses her job after getting caught embezzling, and is no longer able to fund her lavish lifestyle. Faced with being evicted from her rented home, she puts all her skills of deception into fending off the landlord, replacement tenants and a psychotic estate agent. Comedy, starring MyAnna Buring and Tom Rhys Harries

programme.title: Finder's Fee
programme.desc: A man finds a lost wallet and calls the owner so he can get it back. But he then faces a moral dilemma when he discovers it contains a winning lottery ticket worth $6million - especially as his friends are on their way to play poker, and it is traditional for them to bet their tickets. Drama, starring Erik Palladino, James Earl Jones and Ryan Reynolds

programme.title: Death Race 2000
programme.desc: A totalitarian regime keeps the people of a dystopian future America placated with a violent spectacle - a cross country race requires contestants to run down innocent pedestrians, with points awarded for the most brutal kills. However, a revolutionary leader plans to sabotage the barbaric event by smuggling her daughter in as one of the navigators. Satirical sci-fi thriller, starring David Carradine, Sylvester Stallone and Simone Griffeth.

programme.title: A Summer to Remember
programme.desc: A widowed doctor on a holiday with her daughter ends up falling for the owner of the exotic resort. Romantic comedy, starring Catherine Bell and Cameron Mathison

programme.title: The Charm of Love
programme.desc: Romance starring Katrina Norman and Tilky Jones. An archaeologist travels the world searching for the "Lovers' Stone" but finds a man instead.

programme.title: My Birthday Romance
programme.desc: Callie Fitzgerald is tired of her family fixing her up and questioning her single status. She is determined to find a pretend boyfriend for her 35th birthday party just so her folks will leave her alone. What she didn't expect was to actually fall for him. Romantic comedy, starring Ali Cobrin, Jesse Hutch and Charles Cottier

programme.title: The 39 Steps
programme.desc: Classic thriller starring Robert Donat and Madeleine Carroll. An innocent man accused of murder is pursued by both the police and an international spy ring. The beleaguered Richard Hannay finds himself fleeing across the desolate Scottish moors handcuffed to a beautiful woman.

programme.title: Ride in the Whirlwind
programme.desc: Three cowboys, mistaken for outlaws, find themselves pursued by a relentless posse. Western, written, starring and co-produced by Jack Nicholson, with Cameron Mitchell and Harry Dean Stanton

programme.title: A Romance Wedding
programme.desc: Zoe Davis is a successful wedding planner in the big city. When her father asks her for help at the family cafe shop, she drives back to her hometown of Romance, Oregon. Little does she know her mother has already hired Will to help, an aspiring chef and Zoe's childhood sweetheart. Romantic comedy, starring Morgan Kohan and Drew Nelson

programme.title: The Sundowners
programme.desc: An Irish-born sheep drover moves from place to place across the Outback, enjoying the free-and-easy nature of his work. His wife and teenage son, however, are weary of the nomadic way of life and try to persuade him to settle down so they can get a mortgage on a farm. Adventure set in 1920s Australia, starring Robert Mitchum, Deborah Kerr, Peter Ustinov and Ronald Fraser

programme.title: Detective McLean
programme.desc: Police drama following the work of Allison McLean, a tough and experienced detective, mother and wife in suburban Seattle. In the first episode, Allison puts her law-breaking brother Tim behind bars, and quickly decides to move his two resentful teenaged kids in with her own two children and devoted husband. Kelli Williams, Jonathan Scarfe and Luke Perry star

programme.title: Detective McLean
programme.desc: Allison and Devin are called in to investigate the mysterious murder of the owner of a restaurant that hires ex-cons. Meanwhile, Mariah and Cameron try to fit in at their new school, with some unwanted help from Jeff and Rachel

programme.title: Deadly Inferno
programme.desc: Action drama starring David Sutcliffe. As a fire rips through an office building, the local fire service battles to save the trapped workers.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Comedy starring Sigourney Weaver and Jennifer Love Hewitt, and featuring Gene Hackman. Mother-and-daughter con artists Max and Page Conners arrive in Florida looking for their latest victim. But wheezing tobacco baron William B Tensy proves a tough target.

programme.title: Say Your Prayers
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers-turned-radical-Christian hitmen venture to rural Ilkley, under the instruction of the clergyman who raised them, Father Enoch. Their mission is to assassinate Professor John Huxley, a famed atheist writer. Crime comedy, starring Tom Brooke, Harry Melling, Roger Allam and Derek Jacobi

programme.title: Robocop: Prime Directives
programme.desc: Mini-series based on the sci-fi movie about a cyborg police officer. RoboCop goes on the hunt for a ruthless vigilante known only as the Bone Machine - but stumbles across a complex conspiracy which penetrates the highest echelons of the government. Starring Page Fletcher

programme.title: No Joke
programme.desc: While reflecting on his own torment with bullies, musician Andrew Cole embarks on an anti-bullying campaign with the help of some of entertainment's big stars. Documentary.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jonathan Haze and featuring Jack Nicholson. When dim-witted Seymour Krelboined develops a new breed of plant, his position at the Skid Row flower shop looks to be safe. The only problem is, his new creation craves human blood if it is to grow.

programme.title: A Romance Wedding
programme.desc: Zoe Davis is a successful wedding planner in the big city. When her father asks her for help at the family cafe shop, she drives back to her hometown of Romance, Oregon. Little does she know her mother has already hired Will to help, an aspiring chef and Zoe's childhood sweetheart. Romantic comedy, starring Morgan Kohan and Drew Nelson

programme.title: Hint of Love
programme.desc: As a literary agent works with her client on a new cookbook, she must choose between following the directions or her heart. Romantic comedy, starring Debs Howard, Matthew James Dowden and Aadila Dosani

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Leading Lady
programme.desc: An Austrian scientist offers to provide the British government with his experimental new bomb, and Holmes is sent to Vienna to collect it. Before he can take delivery, the device is stolen and he must recover it before several other interested parties get their hands on it. Mystery, with Christopher Lee, Patrick Macnee, Morgan Fairchild and John Bennett

programme.title: Second Chorus
programme.desc: When perennial college students Danny O'Neill (Fred Astaire) & Hank Taylor (Burgess Meredith) are forced to make it on their own, the pair get jobs with Artie Shaw's band and reunite with ex-manager Ellen Miller (Paulette Goddard). Remastered for 4K UHD

programme.title: Made for You with Love
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Edy Ganem and Brendon Zub. A dressmaker who makes a living by upcycling second-hand wedding gowns discovers that fixing her love life is a trickier task.

programme.title: The Great Dictator
programme.desc: Satirical comedy starring Charlie Chaplin. A Jewish barber in a Tomanian ghetto wakes from years of amnesia to find himself a subject of an ominous dictator called Adenoid Hynkel. Resisting the storm troopers who are daubing his shop window, he finds help from Hannah, a downtrodden laundress who also lives in the ghetto.

programme.title: Detective McLean
programme.desc: Allison comes face to face with the man who shot her, and time is running out to charge him and get him off the streets. Matt suspects Cameron of theft. Guest stars Jason Priestley

programme.title: Detective McLean
programme.desc: Allison and Matt discover a dark secret in their friend's marriage, drawing Allison and Devin into a surprising investigation. Mariah's poetry worries her teacher.

programme.title: Infernal
programme.desc: A couple's happy marriage takes a dark turn when their eight-year-old daughter exhibits strange behaviour. They discover that she has been possessed by a demon, and take drastic action to drive the evil spirit out - but saving the child pushes their own relationship to the limit. Horror, starring Andy Ostroff and Heather Adair

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: Comedy starring Brendan Fraser and Elizabeth Hurley. When geeky office worker Elliott Richards says he'd do anything to go out with colleague Alison, he doesn't bank on the Devil appearing as a beautiful woman and offering to help. She gives him seven wishes in exchange for his soul, but her interpretations of his requests mean that Elliott finds it no easy task to get what he wants.

programme.title: The Odd Job
programme.desc: Comedy. A despondent man hires a professional assassin to take himself out. Stars David Jason and Monty Python's Graham Chapman.

programme.title: RoboCop: Prime Directives Part 2 - Meltdown
programme.desc: Thirteen years after the original Robocop, Delta City, considered to be 'The Safest Place On Earth!', has become a futuristic city owned and operated by OCP, and RoboCop, Alex Murphy has begun to feel his age. Murphy finds himself nearly obsolete, although after the murder of his partner and best friend, John Cable, Robocop turns Robokiller!

programme.title: Sight Extended
programme.desc: A man with agoraphobia faces a startling transformation when a powerful AI turns his life into a game. Sci-fi thriller.

programme.title: Sincerely, Yours, Truly
programme.desc: Romance starring Natalie Hall and Marshall Williams. When Grace discovers a wedding ring in a letter left behind in her new condo, she decides to write back. The mysterious lover replies, then writes again and again.

programme.title: Pawparazzi
programme.desc: Family comedy sees a young starlet arrive on location with her pampered dog in tow - but she doesn't get the star treatment she's used to.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: A mermaid princess makes a deal with a sea witch to become human in order to impress a prince. Animated adaptation of the 1989 classic, with the voices of Sonya Krueger, Courage and Steve Guttenberg

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Marnie, a pampered feline who only knows about real life from television, swaps a life of luxury for crime-fighting to clear her name when she and a group of other animals are mistaken for art thieves. Before long they embark on a rollercoaster ride of fun and adventure. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Erik Borner, Alexandra Neldel and Axel Prahl

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: Romance starring Anna Hutchison and Rocky Myers. City executive Jillian inherits her uncle's cabin retreat only to find its rugged maintenance man has been named joint owner.

programme.title: Romance Retreat
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Amanda Schull and Morgan David Jones. A journalist faces a dilemma when she finds herself on a yoga retreat with a handsome guy who happens to be involved in a scandal she's investigating.

programme.title: Northpole
programme.desc: Seasonal fantasy starring Tiffani Thiessen and Max Charles. With everyone now seemingly too busy to enjoy Christmas the way they used to, Santa's home and livelihood come under threat. But young Kevin still believes, and together with his teacher and some new friends sets out to show just how magical the festive season can be.

programme.title: Arctic Blast
programme.desc: A solar eclipse sends a blast of super-chilled air toward Earth, setting off a catastrophic chain of events that threatens to engulf the world in ice and begin a new ice age. Sci-fi thriller, starring Michael Shanks, Bruce Davison, Indiana Evans and Cinthia Burke

programme.title: Zulu Dawn
programme.desc: Historical drama starring Burt Lancaster and Peter O'Toole. 1879: the king of the Zulu nation is goaded into making war so that the British Army can mobilise against him, but the Imperial forces foolishly underestimate the resourcefulness and passion of their adversaries.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: Comedy starring Martin Lawrence and Nia Long. FBI agent Malcolm Turner is a master of disguise, but even his skills are put to the test when he has to impersonate larger-than-life southern matriarch Big Momma Pierce in order to catch a psychopathic bank robber.

programme.title: Ideal Home
programme.desc: Paul Rudd and Steve Coogan -the kings of comedy come together for this must-see film. A big screen match made in heaven in this poignant and endearing comedy as they play a bickering, and flamboyant, couple (with an extensive erotic film collection) whose lavish life is thrown in to turmoil with the sudden appearance of their long-lost grandson. Will the pair be able to take on this new challenge?

programme.title: Robocop: Prime Directives
programme.desc: Mini-series based on the sci-fi movie about a cyborg police officer. RoboCop stumbles across a cult whose members worship him as a god, but is tricked into believing he is a mere human - leaving him vulnerable to attack by the RoboHunters. Starring Page Fletcher

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Romantic comedy spoof starring Alyson Hannigan and Adam Campbell. Julia Jones's parents would like her to settle down with a nice boy who shares her Greek-African-American-Indian-Japanese heritage. But Julia has her sights set on wet-but-handsome Englishman Grant Funkyerdoder, who has no idea what he's letting himself in for.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Comedy starring Spencer Tracy, Joan Bennett and Elizabeth Taylor. Stanley Banks is looking forward to some peace and quiet now that his daughter is married. But his plans are disrupted when she announces that she is going to have a baby.

programme.title: A Stork's Journey
programme.desc: An orphaned sparrow embarks on the challenge of a lifetime when his adopted family of storks leave on their annual migration and he must keep up. Animated family adventure, with the voices of Cooper Kelly Kramer and Shannon Conley

programme.title: Maya the Bee: The Honey Games
programme.desc: An overenthusiastic bee accidentally embarrasses an empress, and is forced to take part in a contest to save her hive. Animated adventure, with the voices of Coco Jack Gillies, Benson Jack Anthony and Richard Roxburgh

programme.title: Legends of Oz: Dorothy's Return
programme.desc: Animated musical adventure featuring the voice of Lea Michele. After briefly returning home to Kansas, Dorothy Gale finds herself back in the magical land of Oz to help save her old friends from the evil Jester, who has stolen the broomstick of the late Wicked Witch of the West.

programme.title: Tin Man
programme.desc: Part one of two. Reimagining of the Wizard of Oz. DG, a student and part-time waitress, finds herself whisked away to a magical realm known as the Outer Zone

programme.title: Tin Man
programme.desc: Reimagining of the Wizard of Oz. Part-time waitress DG struggles to find her way through the Outer Zone, and spots a chance to discover the truth about her mother

programme.title: Eat, Drink and Be Married
programme.desc: Three days before their wedding, Jess and Max are about to call it off. However, Jess begins to question her decision when Max's brother enlists the help of Billie to save the wedding, and in the process starts to fall for her. Romantic drama, starring Jocelyn Hudon, Jake Foy and Sam Robert Muik

programme.title: A Perfect Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic fantasy starring Claire Coffee and Ryan McPartlin. Young executive Holly Maddux wakes after a fall to find that the hunky mannequin she admired in a department store window has come to life and is by her side. Love blossoms, but Holly soon discovers that being perfect all the time is hard work.

programme.title: Krakatoa, East of Java
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Maximilian Schell and Diane Baker. Tension is mounting aboard the Batavia Queen as it sails towards Krakatoa, a volcanic island near Java that's about to become the site of one of the biggest natural catastrophes ever recorded.

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Martin Lawrence and Nia Long. FBI agent Malcolm Turner once again goes under cover, this time to expose the suspected designer of a dangerous computer worm. Re-assuming the disguise of chubby grandma Big Momma, he infiltrates the man's family by posing as a nanny. But crime busting isn't easy when you've got endless household chores and three energetic kids to control.

programme.title: The Professor
programme.desc: A lecturer discovers he has six months to live, and resolves to use the time he has left to the fullest, railing against authority and embracing a newfound hedonistic lifestyle. As the reality of his impending demise sinks in, he resolves to make amends for past mistakes and do what he can for the people who have supported him. Comedy drama, starring Johnny Depp, Rosemarie DeWitt and Odessa Young.

programme.title: Robocop: Prime Directives
programme.desc: Mini-series based on the sci-fi movie about a cyborg police officer. RoboCop joins forces with his son in an attempt to stop evil genius Kaydick from destroying Delta City with a biotech virus. Starring Page Fletcher

programme.title: Meet the Spartans
programme.desc: Spoof of 300 and other historic battle movies, starring Sean Maguire and Carmen Electra. King Leonidas of Sparta leads his men in a battle against troops led by Persian ruler Xerxes, while Leonidas's wife, Queen Margo, makes her own war effort.

programme.title: Second Chorus
programme.desc: When perennial college students Danny O'Neill (Fred Astaire) & Hank Taylor (Burgess Meredith) are forced to make it on their own, the pair get jobs with Artie Shaw's band and reunite with ex-manager Ellen Miller (Paulette Goddard). Remastered for 4K UHD

programme.title: Forever in My Heart
programme.desc: While in Ireland on an internship, Jenna falls in love with the Charlie, the son of the owner of the hotel she has been assigned to, but they end up going their separate ways. Five years later, she returns to Ireland and bumps into Charlie again - and it's immediately clear that they still have feelings for one another. Romantic drama, starring Merritt Patterson and Jack Turner

programme.title: Love in Full Swing
programme.desc: When romance columnist Becks helps her best friend Casey look for love, she soon finds herself facing a dilemma - help Casey or risk opening her heart. Romantic drama, starring Sarah Smyth, Andrew Dunbar and Matthew Kevin Anderson

programme.title: The First of the Few
programme.desc: Second World War biopic of RJ Mitchell, the designer of the Spitfire fighter plane, directed by and starring Leslie Howard, and also starring David Niven. Mitchell and his test pilot Geoffrey Crisp work tirelessly to develop the aeroplane that is destined to play a vital role in the battle against the Luftwaffe.

programme.title: Christmas on Holly Lane
programme.desc: Drama starring Sarah Lancaster, Karen Holness and Gina Holden. Three friends with troubled lives who meet every year for Christmas fear this might be their last together.

programme.title: Sincerely, Yours, Truly
programme.desc: Romance starring Natalie Hall and Marshall Williams. When Grace discovers a wedding ring in a letter left behind in her new condo, she decides to write back. The mysterious lover replies, then writes again and again.

programme.title: Where Angels Fear to Tread
programme.desc: A wealthy widow travels to Italy to escape the pressure of her in-laws, and promptly falls in love with a poor local. When the revived woman agrees to marry her foreign friend, her relatives back home are shocked by the apparent disregard for class, culture and their family's image, and set about putting an end to the unlikely union. Period drama, based on the novel by EM Forster, starring Helena Bonham Carter, Judy Davis and Rupert Graves.

programme.title: Detective McLean
programme.desc: The complicated relationship between two brothers clouds an investigation for Allison and Devin. When Matt takes Allison on a romantic date, Cameron and Mariah break house rules, challenging Rachel and Jeff

programme.title: Detective McLean
programme.desc: Allison and Devin investigate the breakdown of a star student at the high school and the teens deal with the social fallout of having Allison on campus. Guest stars C. Thomas Howell

programme.title: Married by Christmas
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring April Bowlby and Jes Macallan. When two sisters discover that their father's company will be inherited by whichever one marries first, the sister who has worked to build the business begins a frantic search for a husband.

programme.title: Berlin, I Love You
programme.desc: Ten dramatic stories of love, redemption and acceptance set against the backdrop of the German capital. The tales include a man who has come to Berlin to drink himself to death, and a refugee worker who takes a young child home. Starring Keira Knightley, Helen Mirren, Luke Wilson, Jim Sturgess and Mickey Rourke. Among the assorted directors is Glee veteran Dianna Agron (who co-stars), and Peter Chelsom (Hear My Song/Serendipity)

programme.title: Winged Creatures
programme.desc: The survivors of a massacre begin to rethink their outlook on life. A compulsive gambler indulges his addiction even further, feeling he has ultimate proof of his good luck. A waitress neglects her baby, a doctor subjects his wife to unusual treatments and a teenager uses her experience to boost her social standing at school. Drama, starring Kate Beckinsale, Forest Whitaker and Guy Pearce.

programme.title: Webcam Cheerleaders
programme.desc: Maisy heads to her late sister's college to dig into the truth about what happened to her. She finds out that many of the girls on the cheer squad are also working as webcam models. But sharing what she learns could be risky.

programme.title: Casuals: The Story of the Legendary Terrace Fashion
programme.desc: Some thirty years ago, a working-class subculture was taking grip of cities across the UK that has left a lasting legacy. Produced and researched by Cass Pennant, this film strips away the myth and will give you the real story of an often over-looked casual movement that birthed in cities like Liverpool, Manchester and London.

programme.title: Puppy Time
